source.name: A site's forum, asked which forum software it runs

site.description: the forum's host name, such as community.shopify.com; mull reads its robots.txt first

address.description: the forum's home page on the site, for a forum that lives under a path, such as https://www.bogleheads.org/forum/; https://<site>/ when left out

channel: The forum's host name, one channel per site.
audiences: people who talk on a site's own forum, such as a vendor's customer community or a trade's board

terms.licence: forum-engine reads only a site's description of itself, its about.json and its home page's markers, stores no one's words and writes one name, so it reads every site under one standing posture instead of each site's terms: robots.txt obeyed, the groups naming readers for language models included; one request per 2 seconds; two pages at most; nothing kept but the name and the raw answers. The owner's standing ruling for research is its basis.

obtain.how: Two pages are read as any visitor who is not signed in reads them: the forum's about.json, then its home page. mull asks for the site's robots.txt first (reads_pages) and follows RFC 9309, as for web-page, including the groups naming readers for language models. A 401 or 403, or an answer carrying a bot challenge, writes no name and is never worked around. It sends User-Agent: mull, and keeps one request per 2 seconds across every run on the machine.

subject.name: The configured site, as given.
subject.identifiers: One domain identifier: the configured site in lowercase, without a leading www.

observation.subject_identifier: The site's domain identifier, as for its subject.
observation.value: The first name in categories.forum_engine whose rule matches, tried in order.
observation.at: The received_at of the answer that gave the name.
observation.url: The address of the answer that gave the name: about.json for discourse, the home page for the others.
observation.unit: None: a name has no unit.

forum_engine.name: discourse
forum_engine.rule: about.json, read relative to the forum's home page, answers 200 with JSON whose about.version is a string, as Discourse's does (community.shopify.com: 2026.11.0-latest.1 on 2026-11-13).

forum_engine.name: phpbb
forum_engine.rule: The home page answers 200 with HTML holding <body id="phpbb", the body phpBB's own templates open with (www.bogleheads.org/forum, three captures kept in test/fixtures/phpbb-forum/pages).

forum_engine.name: khoros
forum_engine.rule: The home page answers 200 with HTML holding LITHIUM.CommunityJsonObject, the script object Khoros (formerly Lithium) communities set (community.squareup.com on 2026-11-13).

forum_engine.name: unknown
forum_engine.rule: Both pages were read and no rule above matched.
